plugins.name: jpyc-dev-reference
plugins.description: Developer reference for JPYC, a JPY-pegged stablecoin (日本円ステーブルコイン) deployed on Ethereum, Polygon, and Avalanche. Provides contract addresses, ERC20 functions, EIP-3009 gasless transfer signatures, EIP-2612 permit, admin/role operations (mint, burn, pause, blocklist), EIP712 domain configuration, type hashes, error messages, and TypeScript/viem code examples.
